description: HelpYouSponsor lets authenticated HYS admins search and summarize records from their HYS workspace in ChatGPT. The app helps review donors, gifts, sponsorships, recipients, dashboard snapshots, notes and activity logs, saved filters, and saved reports while preserving HYS permission-set and workspace boundaries.
